cells.notes: MEASURED 2026-11-16 on real RB3 Gen 2 silicon, per-graph AI Hub profiles (estimated_inference_time), w4a16, context 512, manual API chain. Text backbone = 4 parts x 2 graphs. Prompt ar128 (us per 128 tok): part2 68,980 (job jp42392vg), part3 69,011 (jp1m66z8p), part4 36,122 (jgj8qql15). Decode ar1 (us per tok): part2 20,224 (jp423ymqg), part3 20,300 (jp3r6z6xp), part4 22,291 (jp0x6ov0p). PART 1 (layers 0-8) AND THE VISION ENCODER COULD NOT BE PROFILED: all 9 compiles succeed, but on-device QnnModel_composeGraphsFromDlc fails with MODEL_GRAPH_ERROR for part1 both graphs (5 attempts) and the vision encoder (3 attempts); linking the text graphs fails naming FP32 tensor '/model/model/layers.2/mlp/down_proj/Conv_bias' as not supported by the targeted device. Recompiling part1 with -O1 instead of -O0 (job jp1m6kvnp) does not change the compose failure, ruling out compile options. Maintainer clarification (qualcomm/ai-hub-models #369, 2026-11-16): the FP32 layer is intentional, kept in floating point to improve output quality; RB3 Gen 2 only supports integer math and was never a supported device for this model - an intentional mixed-precision design incompatible with the RB3 integer-only path, not an asset defect. Full-model prefill/decode therefore UNKNOWN; measured parts 2-4 alone sum to prompt 174,113 us and decode 62,815 us/tok. First public QCS6490 attempt for this VLM.
